title: SourceBundle
description: Path-independent source bundle identity for copybook provenance (#1116). Stability class: beta. Reference for the copybook_core::SourceBundle contract; the Rust type is authoritative.

stability_class.description: Stability class of the v1 bundle contract.

root.description: Logical identity of the root unit. Never a workstation path.

units.description: Ordered material source units; ordering is semantic.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 over the unit's raw bytes.

include_support.description: Include collection is unsupported; the graph is empty.

unresolved_includes.description: Declared but unresolvable includes; empty while unsupported.

encoding.description: Text encoding the bytes were read with.

line_endings.description: Raw bytes hashed as read; the lexer accepts LF and CRLF.

declared_dialect.description: Dialect declaration intrinsic to the source set, if any. The current parser detects none, so this is null.

labels.description: Optional non-sensitive provenance labels, explicitly excluded from the fingerprint.

fingerprint_algo.description: Fingerprint algorithm over the canonical identity bytes.

fingerprint.description: Bundle fingerprint: SHA-256 over the canonical identity bytes.
